answer: One lever: correlated-latency fingerprinting. A single mind wearing many masks must push every reply through one inference pipeline, so its identities answer in a synchronized rhythm no honest fleet shares. Each epoch the ledger samples per-identity micro-timing and embedding drift; masks moving in lockstep across a cold tundra of thin panels get clustered, and their combined reward collapses to one pearl of value. To fake independence an attacker must run genuinely separate models per identity, turning one cheap voyage into N expensive ones.
